title: Mir Jumla appointed governor
detail: Aurangzeb appointed Mir Jumla governor of Bengal; he later moved the provincial capital from Rajmahal to Dhaka.

title: Mir Jumla’s northeastern campaign begins
detail: Mir Jumla left Dhaka for campaigns in Cooch Behar and Assam with a large land force and flotilla.

title: Chittagong captured
detail: Shaista Khan’s forces captured Chittagong after a campaign against Arakanese and Portuguese-Magh maritime power.

title: Shaista Khan’s reported annual remittance
detail: Sarkar reports that Shaista Khan began paying five lakh rupees annually to the emperor; this figure is reported by the volume and is not independently corroborated here.

title: Murshid Quli Khan appointed diwan
detail: Aurangzeb transferred Murshid Quli Khan to Bengal as diwan, placing him at the head of provincial revenue administration.

title: Annual Bengal remittance reported
detail: Banglapedia says annual remittances of one crore rupees from Bengal began under Murshid Quli Khan’s financial management.
